title: THE AIR STRIKE NAMES YOUR KEYS
why: Found in the cloud hunt of 2026-10-15: the air strike prompts were written out by hand, so they ignored rebinding. With the air strike key moved from G to K the ready plate still said G and the aim line still said G CANCEL. With CHANGE PAD BUTTONS moving previous gun to Y the chord is really Y and RB, but the plate, the aim line and AIR STRIKE READY still said LB+RB. Proven in headless Chromium: {"kbReadyLabel":["G"],"padAimAfterPhysLBRB":0,"padAimAfterPhysYRB":1,"padReadyLabel":["LB+RB"],"pbn4":"Y","pbn5":"RB","padAimLine":["RT CALL     LB + RB CANCEL"]}. The three prompts now read the key and the buttons as set; on the defaults they read exactly as before.
now: The air strike prompts name the key and the controller buttons you set, not always G and LB + RB.

edits.anchor: c.font=hudFS(TYPE.micro); c.fillStyle=UIC.tx_2; hudText((padOn()?pbn(7):'LMB')+' CALL     '+(padOn()?padB('LB + RB'):'G')+' CANCEL',s.x,s.y-ar-U(8));
edits.replacement:
// v16.xx (cloud-menus-air-strike-keys), CLOUD HUNT 2026-10-15: the cancel names the key and the buttons as set (G moved to K says K; previous gun moved to Y says Y + RB)
    c.font=hudFS(TYPE.micro); c.fillStyle=UIC.tx_2; hudText((padOn()?pbn(7):'LMB')+' CALL     '+(padOn()?padB(pbn(4)+' + '+pbn(5)):keyName(keysOf('KeyG')))+' CANCEL',s.x,s.y-ar-U(8));

edits.replacement:
// v16.xx (cloud-menus-air-strike-keys), CLOUD HUNT 2026-10-15: AIR STRIKE READY names the key and the chord as set: the chord reads the buttons after CHANGE PAD BUTTONS, and G can move
function airHint(){ return (typeof padOn==='function'&&padOn())?padB(pbn(4)+' + '+pbn(5)):'PRESS '+keyName(keysOf('KeyG')); }
